verdict.rationale: Terraform documents passing input variables at apply time via -var and -var-file (terraform-docs-46), so values can be supplied outside the committed configuration. A community user mentions 'sensitive variables' in Terraform Cloud/Enterprise, but also reports that secrets retrieved via the CLI end up unencrypted in state (terraform-comm-6). Remote backends are recommended for secure state storage (terraform-docs-33). missing for 10: documented sensitive-value marking or redaction in plan/apply output and logs, a first-party secrets-manager integration or encrypted secret handling, protection of secrets in state, and independent hands-on corroboration.
